label: Zip Fly (Nylon)
description: A nylon (coil) zip fly uses a lightweight plastic-toothed zipper, which is thin, flexible and lies very flat behind the fly. It keeps the front of the trouser smooth with no visible hardware and is quiet and snag-resistant. The low profile makes it well suited to lighter-weight and summer cloths where bulk would show.
